description: This file defines the interface for the ByteWriter class, which provides methods for writing various data types to a byte buffer, including bytes, uint32, int64, and C strings. It is part of the firebolt::rialto::common namespace and appears to be used for serialization or buffer manipulation within the project.

classes.name: ByteWriter
classes.description: An abstract class providing methods for writing different data types to a byte buffer, intended to be subclassed for specific implementations.

methods.name: writeByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes multiple bytes to the buffer starting at the specified offset.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with a specified byte for a given count starting at the offset.

methods.name: writeUint32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: writeInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit signed integer to the buffer.

methods.name: writeCString
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated C string to the buffer.
